# conftest Module

**Path:** `tests/parity/conftest.py`

## Description

pytest configuration for the ARC-011 parity suite.

Registers the ``parity`` marker so ``-m parity`` selects the suite and
``--strict-markers`` (if ever enabled) does not reject it.
